primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The number of participants with adverse events was used as the measure for the long-term safety and tolerability of tirasemtiv.

groups.description: The Delayed Start Treatment group consisted of patients who received placebo in CY 4031 and tirasemtiv in CY 4033.
groups.title: Delayed Start Treatment

groups.description: The Early Start Treatment group consisted of patients who received tirasemtiv in both CY 4031 and CY 4033.
groups.title: Early Start Treatment

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The data are presented for the Safety Analysis Set, which consisted of all patients who enrolled and received at least 1 dose of tirasemtiv in Study CY 4033.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.timeFrame: From the first dose of tirasemtiv through 28 days after the last dose
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Number of Participants With Adverse Events
